title_lines: 伊朗新袭击冲击石油市场

subtitles.en: Chris, before we consider the wider economic outlook and how it factors into the midterms, let's consider the trajectory possibly of oil prices.
subtitles.zh: Chris，在讨论更广泛的经济前景及其对中期选举的影响之前，我们先看看油价可能的走势。

subtitles.en: Do you think this renewed tension in the state of Ramuzzi attacks on these vessels, the subsequent strikes the U.S. is now conducting will result in materially higher prices,
subtitles.zh: 你认为拉穆齐地区紧张局势升级、船只遇袭以及美国随后发动的打击，会导致油价大幅上涨吗？

subtitles.en: at least in the short term? So, we saw a little jump in oil prices after this latest announcement from Treasury that they were revoking the waiver.
subtitles.zh: 至少短期内？我们看到财政部宣布撤销豁免后油价小幅上涨。

subtitles.en: And then of course, I think when markets open again, we'll see another jump.
subtitles.zh: 当然，市场再次开盘时，我们预计还会看到一波上涨。

subtitles.en: Right now the world has a lot of oil. I think the risk is that what we've seen is a declining gas price domestically, which is what consumers really care about.
subtitles.zh: 目前全球石油供应充足。我认为风险在于国内天然气价格下跌，这才是消费者真正关心的。
en_highlights: world has a lot of oil

subtitles.en: Hasn't been declining as much as oil prices. There's still a lot of uncertainty in these oil product markets, and there's still a lot of work to be done to normalize global energy markets.
subtitles.zh: 但天然气价格跌幅不如油价。石油产品市场仍存在很大不确定性，全球能源市场正常化还有很长的路要走。

subtitles.en: So yes, I think what we've seen today is that the ceasefire is very fragile, and anything that upends it for a period of time will of course put more pressure
subtitles.zh: 是的，今天我们看到停火协议非常脆弱，任何破坏协议的行为都会给全球能源市场带来更大压力。

subtitles.en: on global energy markets, especially as these emergency releases start to end, because we are going to run out of these emergency releases
subtitles.zh: 尤其是随着紧急储备释放接近尾声，我们大概在9月下旬就会耗尽这些储备。
zh_highlights: 紧急储备释放接近尾声
